subject: Package size 35.5 mb after including compiled nimble functions in R.

messages.author: ca4bf030fdc43964
messages.subject: Package size 35.5 mb after including compiled nimble functions in R.
parts:
Hi All
I am making a package that "Depends" on Nimble (without nimble, it can't operate) so I put it in depends in description file. The whole package has 30+ nimble functions. When I am checking the package with devtools::rcheck(), I am getting a note that installed package size is 35.3+ mb. I am planning to submit the package to CRAN so the size must be < 5.0 mb.  My guess is devtools::build is compiling all the nimblefunctions while making the package which is causing the size. With all the vignettes , tests, data and other accessories the size of whole package is < 2 mb. Any suggestions on how to reduce the size of the package will be a great help.

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: Package size 35.5 mb after including compiled nimble functions in R.
parts:
Hi,

Packages submitted to CRAN should not have any compiled code in them (i.e., they are "source" packages containing only source code). This is, in part, because the compiled code will differ by operating system.

If you build the package with `R CMD build` is the package size still so large? I wouldn't think it would be -- `compileNimble` shouldn't be being invoked.
More generally, you should only have `compileNimble` being invoked inside of functions in your packages -- so it would only be called when a user of your package runs one of your functions. Nothing in your code should cause `compileNimble` to be called when `R CMD build` or `R CMD INSTALL --build` are run. (The latter creates binary packages from the source package, which is what CRAN does to create the MacOS and Windows binaries after you submit your package to CRAN.)

I'm happy to discuss further as you investigate more.

-chris
